SAB234 — APKINA

A lightweight, collapsible tripod for photography, live streaming and content creation.

SPECIFICATIONS
Height range: Approximately 56 in (142 cm), or around 160 cm maximum depending on the variant.
Head movement: Pan/tilt or panoramic movement, depending on the mounted head setup.
Carry bag: Often supplied; inclusion depends on the listing.
